description: This file implements the TpmResourceManager class and related classes for managing TPM resources, including resource allocation, deallocation, and synchronization mechanisms within the Android Open Source Project's secure environment.

classes.name: EsysLock
classes.description: A lock wrapper for ESYS_CONTEXT to ensure thread-safe access.

classes.name: TpmResourceManager::ObjectSlot
classes.description: Represents a slot for a TPM resource, managing its lifecycle and cleanup.

classes.name: TpmResourceManager
classes.description: Manages TPM resource slots, including allocation, deallocation, and synchronization.

methods.name: EsysLock
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the lock with a given ESYS_CONTEXT and mutex guard.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::ObjectSlot::ObjectSlot
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an ObjectSlot with a resource manager and optional resource handle.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::ObjectSlot::~ObjectSlot
methods.description: Destructor that releases the TPM resource if allocated.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::TpmResourceManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resource manager with a given ESYS_CONTEXT.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::~TpmResourceManager
methods.description: Destructor that checks for outstanding resource slots.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::Esys
methods.description: Returns an EsysLock object for thread-safe access to the ESYS_CONTEXT.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::ReserveSlot
methods.description: Reserves a TPM resource slot if available, otherwise returns nullptr.
